section1.title: Voice Summary
section1.subtitle: Turn conversations into clear insights.
section1.description: AI listens to your voice conversations and turns long discussions into concise summaries, helping you quickly catch the key points, decisions, and important information without listening back to everything.

section2.title: Project Assistant
section2.subtitle: Your AI teammate for getting things done.
section2.description: AI helps you organize projects, find important information, keep track of tasks, and stay on top of your work — so your team can spend less time managing and more time building.

section3.title: Interview Agent
section3.subtitle: You answer. AI asks.
section3.description: AI conducts natural interviews by asking relevant questions, listening to your answers, and following up intelligently — making interviews, research, and feedback collection faster and more engaging.

questions.question: What is AI Agent?
questions.answer: AI Agent is an intelligent assistant integrated into Mezon to automate workflows, summarize voice channels, manage projects, and conduct interactive interviews.

questions.question: How does Voice Summary work?
questions.answer: Voice Summary listens to your voice meetings or conversations in Mezon, processes the audio transcript, and provides key takeaways, decisions, and action items instantly.

questions.question: Can I customize AI Agent for my Clan?
questions.answer: Yes, AI Agent can be customized to suit your team's specific requirements, workflows, and integrations.
